# Bevelled plates thinner than two bevels and slabs with holes, placed and joined as a family joins them (Blender
# 5.2.2, gamekit: a plain box 0.1 x 0.06 x 0.04 at (0.05, -0.3, 0.31) first, the part at (-0.2, 0.632, 0.52),
# parts.join with its origin at (0, 0, 0)): rec <name> kind width segments ... as in bevel.txt, a slab's outlines
# (loops), and the joined mesh: v points, f faces, n a normal a corner as Blender reads the bevel's stored angles on
# the mesh once moved (not always of unit length). Floats as bits. slab/frame2 is bevelled in two segments: where two
# of its rim's strips meet between their segments, the normal Blender reads hangs on which of the two edges its
# mesh numbers first, and so on the order its extrusion made the far face's edges in. plate/strip and plate/light are
# bevelled by exactly half their thickness: their sides close up to nothing, and Blender reads no normal at all (zero)
# at eight corners there, which its exporter writes as straight up.
